_comment: Hand-curated provenance (no metrics). 'citation_status': verified_in_repo = the identifier appears in committed reports/docs; not_recorded_in_repo = only the title is known here, the identifier has not been checked. Edit when a citation is verified.

papers.title: Anti-UAV: A Large Multi-Modal Benchmark for UAV Tracking
papers.role: Direction B: the reproduced paper (DFSC training strategy on GlobalTrack, Protocol II); also defines the state-accuracy metric mSA (Eq. 1) used by both directions

papers.title: GlobalTrack: A Simple and Strong Baseline for Long-term Tracking
papers.role: Direction B base tracker (query-guided Faster R-CNN, ResNet-50-FPN); re-implemented with torchvision, checkpoint converted

papers.title: CST Anti-UAV (thermal infrared tiny-UAV tracking benchmark)
papers.role: Benchmark + official toolkit (no method). Shared evaluation protocol: Direction A's X1 / X2 / CF are scored under it; its Table 3 baselines are reproduced from the authors' released predictions

papers.title: Ultralytics YOLO11 (software release, not a paper)
papers.role: Direction A detector backbone / head; COCO-pretrained yolo11n.pt initialisation

papers.title: No More Strided Convolutions or Pooling (SPD-Conv)
papers.role: Direction A component, evaluated and RETIRED as a claim (no effect once initialisation is fair)

papers.title: ByteTrack: Multi-Object Tracking by Associating Every Detection Box
papers.role: Direction A tracker, evaluated and RETIRED (loses to argmax single-target baseline)

papers.title: SORT / constant-velocity Kalman filtering (classical)
papers.role: Direction A: SORT control tracker; the STE's Kalman state follows the classical CV model

papers.title: HOTA: A Higher Order Metric for Evaluating Multi-Object Tracking
papers.role: Track C tracking metric (re-implemented, cross-checked against TrackEval)

papers.title: Det-Fly dataset
papers.role: Direction A detector training data (bird hard negatives)
